entities.name: Drosophila glob1
observations: Reduced glob1 expression causes oogenesis abnormalities associated with improperly formed F-actin cytoskeleton; somatic and germline clone analyses support a cell-autonomous maintenance role.

entities.name: PMID:27503269
observations: 2016 Developmental Dynamics study: glob1 has a cell-autonomous role in maintaining F-actin-based cytoskeletal integrity in somatic and germ-cell derivatives during Drosophila oogenesis.

entities.name: glob1-F-actin oogenesis
observations: Reduced glob1 produces oogenesis abnormalities primarily mediated by improper F-actin-based cytoskeleton formation; clonal analyses indicate cell-autonomous maintenance function.
